text: Learn to rejoice with others. When you hear about another person’s success or happiness, close your eyes and feel their joy not as “their” event, but as energy that fills and resonates in you. After all, it is so simple - feel it, rejoice in it, celebrate it. It does not matter where the source of this energy is, and there is no need to appropriate it - it flows from infinity to infinity, and at this point in space-time it will not linger for long, like any living energy. What matters is that at this moment it fills you and makes you happier. Open the miracles of the heart!
